badge.line-height.$description: Line height for badge labels — tight (1) prevents extra vertical space from browser default

button.line-height.$description: Line height for button labels — tight (1) prevents extra vertical space from browser default

button.border-width.$description: Line height for button labels — tight (1) prevents extra vertical space from browser default

sheet.content.width.default.$description: Default width for left/right sheet panels before size modifier is applied

toast.destructive.text.$description: Text color on destructive toast (saturated red background)

toast.success.text.$description: Text color on success toast (saturated green background)

toast.warning.text.$description: Text color on warning toast (saturated orange background)

toggle-group.item-height.$description: Height of toggle group items (40px, matches default toggle height)

resizable.grip-icon-size.$description: Size of the grip icon inside the resizable handle (xs icon, 12px)

input.padding-y.sm.$description: Vertical padding for sm input — space.100 (8px) + font-size.sm (14px) = 30px total height

input.padding-y.md.$description: Vertical padding for md input — space.150 (12px) + font-size.base (16px) = 40px total height

input.padding-y.lg.$description: Vertical padding for lg input — space.200 (16px) + font-size.lg (18px) = 50px total height
